$comment: Canonical tool definitions for toolcall-serving-bench. Generic-ERP vocabulary only, expanded from the standard ERP module set (master/sales/purchase/inventory/accounting/hr/report). Near-duplicate functions are placed WITHIN each module on purpose so that selection difficulty grows with tool-set size. Argument scoring mode is carried by x-scoring and is stripped from the model-facing view.

scoring_convention.note: A field is scored semantically iff x-scoring == 'semantic'. Everything else is exact. String values are NFKC-normalized and stripped on both sides before the exact comparison, so full-width/half-width variants match but synonyms do not. 2.1.0: no field is semantic any more -- attribute/section names became enums, and free-text search terms are scored normalized-exact, so scoring is fully mechanical with no judge model.

tool_set_stages.$comment: Tool count is an experiment variable: the same cases are run under each stage to produce a selection-accuracy degradation curve. Stage sizes must be large enough to hold the correct tool plus all declared distractors (max 3 here), so the smallest usable stage is 5, not 3. The top stage equals the full catalogue.

tools.name: search_master
tools.description: マスタデータから単一レコードの属性を引く。取引先・品目・部門などの実体を、コードまたは名称で特定して登録属性を返す。文書検索や複数レコードの集計には使わない。

tools.name: search_report

metric.description: 定型指標。定型外は query_text のみ使う

query_text.description: 文書内で探したい内容の自由記述

tools.name: compare_period_metric
tools.description: 同一数量を2期間で比較し差分を返す。単一期間の集計や時系列推移ではなく、2点間の増減が求められている場合に使う。

tools.name: list_pending_sales_approvals

tools.name: list_pending_purchase_approvals
